prose: Discover the unauthorized history of the world after the last great flood, described in the pages of the Oera Linda manuscript. Although accused of being a forgery by mainstream academia, this text contains a philosophy and worldview that, if at all true, may help us comprehend how our society has degenerated since the lofty Bronze Age, through the dark times up to now. Dylan Saccoccio joins us to discuss this fascinating text that you likely have never encountered before now.
music: Vibe Rant intro theme by VOLO
